dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Hey cutie, are you here at the Grand Bazaar to catch some performances?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you like the performances here?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Yes, they are quite amusing. I even wonder if I should start taking notes on the formats of some of the programs. Who knows? Perhaps it'll come in handy for the next Ludi Harpastum.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Kaeya could take charge of the jokes, but dancing might prove to be a little tricky.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you seen the dancing here before?

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: Yes, there was a lovely girl with red hair dancing yesterday. I had a front row seat, it was really something.

dialogues.speaker: Lisa
dialogues.text: I can't help but wonder how great it would be to see similar performances in Mondstadt.

choices.text: You just have to convince Nilou to perform in Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Actually, I think the biggest challenge would be to get Eula, Captain of the Reconnaissance Company, to show some interest in dancing, as well as to find a beautiful outfit she would agree to wear.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So you're trying to get Eula involved?

response.speaker: Lisa
response.text: Eula is surprisingly gullible when it comes to certain things. Rather than inviting the performers to Mondstadt, it would be easier to trick... ah, I mean, ask her to dance.
